en: A black and white photograph of a large, multi-story institutional building with a tile roof and extensive balconies, standing in a landscaped area. The building appears to be early to mid-20th century in style. The text at the bottom left corner says 'Wettinstift - Männerheim.' The setting is calm, with some trees and open grass in the foreground. The architectural style is typical of German-speaking Central Europe from the early 20th century.
